songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Five on the board
That is apparently enough

[Verse 1]
We reach the platform out of breath
Not from running, just from talking too long
The board says five beside your line
You look at it, then look away too fast
I say five minutes is practically forever
You say that is not how minutes work
A station worker folds a little sign
Somebody rolls a suitcase past us
The whole place is getting ready to finish
We are somehow still starting new sentences

[Hook]
Five More Minutes
Tell me the part you skipped outside
Five More Minutes
The train can keep being just a number
You laugh and say I am bargaining badly
I say it is still worth trying
Five More Minutes

[Verse 2]
You check the small photo from this afternoon
The one where I looked away too late
I accuse you of keeping the worst frame
You say it is currently the best evidence
That I can stand still for half a second
The board changes from five to four
Neither of us mentions it immediately
We talk about the bakery instead
About a sign with one letter missing
About anything that is not the clock

[Hook Reprise]
Five more minutes
Even if there are only four

[Bridge]
Your phone goes dark between us
The platform light catches the silver edge
You say we should probably move closer to the door mark
We do not move yet

[Final Hook]
Five More Minutes
Enough for one more completely useless story
Five More Minutes
Enough to make the platform feel smaller
The board changes again behind you
You notice, then smile instead of saying it
Five More Minutes

[Outro]
Three vibraphone notes under the station hum
